Une mobilisation conjointe pour répondre: A joint mobilization to meet urgent needs
Ooredoo Algérie, en partenariat avec l'A: Ooredoo Algeria, in partnership with ANV, has launched an emergency operation aimed at supporting the victims of the fires that ravaged several areas of the wilaya of Jijel. This initiative is part of a civic commitment and ongoing mobilization to support populations affected by these natural disasters.
La caravane humanitaire, composée notamm: The humanitarian caravan, consisting notably of electric generators and basic necessities, was deployed under the supervision of the president of ANV, Mr. Ahmed Melha, and the director of institutional affairs, communication and corporate social responsibility of Ooredoo, Mr. Ramdane Djazairi. This action illustrates the depth of the partnership between the two structures and their shared willingness to meet the real needs of disaster-stricken families.
Les aides humanitaires ont d'abord été c: The humanitarian aid was first centralized in a warehouse dedicated to the collection of donations, located in the commune of El Aouana, before being distributed according to needs identified on the ground. The teams of Ooredoo and ANV then went to the most affected areas, notably in the heights of the commune of Djemaa Beni Habibi, to bring direct support to local populations.
Parmi les actions menées, la distributio: Among the actions carried out, the distribution of electric generators to disaster-stricken families helped mitigate the consequences of the exceptional situation caused by the fires. These generators aim to alleviate frequent power outages in the affected areas.
Le directeur général d'Ooredoo Algérie,: The General Manager of Ooredoo Algeria, Mr. Rony Tohmé, emphasized the importance of this initiative:
« Face aux incendies qui ont touché plus: "Faced with the fires that affected several regions of the country, Ooredoo Algeria expresses its deep solidarity with the families affected by this tragedy. Through this operation, we wish to embody our willingness to help alleviate the difficulties encountered by the disaster-stricken families. This initiative adds to the operation launched by the Ooredoo Foundation, which offered free calls and internet for seven days to its customers in the affected wilayas, thus reflecting our responsibility as a corporate citizen and our commitment alongside citizens, particularly in difficult times."
For his part, the president of ANV, Mr. Ahmed Melha, welcomed this initiative:
« Nous apprécions cette action de solida: "We appreciate this solidarity action launched by Ooredoo Algeria, which concretely embodies the importance of collective mobilization in the face of emergency situations. The provision of electric generators and essential products responds to real needs identified on the ground and will help support disaster-stricken families. We thank Ooredoo Algeria for its trust and civic commitment, and reaffirm our willingness to continue our efforts in the service of society and to contribute to anchoring the values of national solidarity."
Cette initiative s'inscrit dans la conti: This initiative is part of the ongoing corporate social responsibility commitments of Ooredoo Algérie, focusing on solidarity and supporting populations, particularly in emergencies or crises. It follows similar actions carried out during the fires that affected the wilayas of Taref and Souk Ahras in 2022, as well as in 2023, thus reaffirming the operator's unconditional commitment to Algerian society.
